notes.title: X8 Major Update - Freeplay Park
notes.content:
Hi everyone!! 

[b]We are ready to drop a new Update: Freeplay Park!!![/b] 

Thank you all for your support, and we're excited to see the new faces this new update will bring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925441/3f04225414389e5bf1bbab8359006512b612286a.png[/img]

Introducing:
[b]Major Update - Freeplay Park[/b]

[b]Freeplay Park:[/b] This new park area is the player’s social hub in X8. Hang out, meet new friends, and form custom games. You can also engage in various activities such as participating in minigames like time attack climbing challenges, knife throwing, and a shooting range, or practicing in the combat arena.

[b]Streamlined Friend Adding: [/b]Simplified process for adding friends in-game with a single click from the team menu.

[b]Splat Tags:[/b] Adding a splash of color and personalization to gameplay, Splat Tags are digital slime balls that allow players to leave custom stickers in the environment. These can be purchased in the X8 store or unlocked through the event calendar.

[b]New Weapon - MONARCH:[/b] Introducing the MONARCH, a high-skill, semi-automatic weapon perfect for mid-spend rounds.

[b]Threat Levels Ranked Game Mode:[/b] Introducing “Threat Levels,” a pseudo-ranked game mode for demolition. Perform well and win games to increase threat rating, represented by a badge in the main menu, showcasing your skills.

[b]Weapon Recoil and Sound Overhaul:[/b] We have completely revamped the weapon and sound systems, offering a refreshed experience for veteran players and a better first impression for newcomers.

[b]Enhanced Matchmaking System:[/b] Ensures that players are ready before joining a game, preventing AFK disruptions. This system ties into the new Threat Levels feature, creating a more competitive and balanced gaming experience.


Your help in identifying bugs and providing feedback has been invaluable in making X8 what it is today, and will continue to do so in the future. Please continue supporting us with bug reports and suggestions in the Discord! https://discord.gg/x8vr

Introducing:
[b]Major Update - Rush Respawn[/b]

Last Major Update, we introduced the new Rush game mode. This time, we're taking it up a notch with [b]Rush Respawn[/b]! Get right back into the action as soon as you're down in quick, chaotic 4 round matches.

We've also introduced the first steps of [b]Skill-Based Matchmaking[/b] in this update! The more you play, the better your matchups! We'll be posting our highest MMR achievers in our [url=discord.gg/x8vr]Discord server[/url]

New in this update as well is [b]Leaderboard Challenges[/b] ! Compete for the top spot and improve your personal best in rotating leaderboard challenges! **Please note that only matches played in Demolition will count towards your spot on the leaderboard.

And more!

Your help in identifying bugs and providing feedback has been invaluable in making X8 what it is today, and will continue to do so in the future. Please continue supporting us with bug reports and suggestions in the Discord! https://discord.gg/x8vr


If you have been enjoying the game, please consider leaving us a review on the Steam store page, we'd really appreciate it!

notes.title: Update on Closed Beta and a few words from X8 Producer
notes.content:
Hello everyone, todya we have an important announcement regarding the upcoming closed beta:

First off, we'd like to express our gratitude for your incredible support over the past couple weeks. It's been an unexpected and very welcome surprise, and it's been amazing to connect with so many VR fans who are so excited to play X8.

To better reflect this amount of support, we've decided to provide you with a beta with more features than our initial plan, and so that it's overall a much better experience for everyone. This means that we'll be delaying the closed beta to early January.

If you already signed up for the closed beta, don't fret! We'll be holding on to the applications for this new date. If you were not able to apply for the beta, we will also be providing additional opportunities for people to receive beta keys and join the closed beta, so keep your eyes peeled on [url=https://discord.gg/x8vr]Discord[/url] and other socials!

Before taking a break for the holidays, we would also like to share this blog from X8 Executive Producer Masaru Ohnogi with more insights about the game: https://link.medium.com/rXMxCClXTvb 

Thank you again for the incredible amount of support you have been showing us, and stay tuned for updates! Enjoy your holidays!
